# Image preparation fixtures

- `small.bmp` and `animated.gif` are generated locally by `scripts/test-image-formats.mjs`; the GIF contains red then green frames to prove that normalization freezes the first frame.
- `small.webp` is generated by Chromium canvas encoding in the same test. Its two color blocks validate real decoding rather than a filename-only conversion.
- `color.avif` is the unmodified `tests/data/colors-animated-8bpc.avif` from the official [libavif repository](https://github.com/AOMediaCodec/libavif/blob/17bdf4c63cb7d84fc9ce4cbf47e94cff3538d93f/tests/data/colors-animated-8bpc.avif), commit `17bdf4c63cb7d84fc9ce4cbf47e94cff3538d93f`, 1,235 bytes. Its upstream license is retained in `libavif-LICENSE`.

These test-only raster files are never shipped as product media or submitted to a hosted API.
